# Human Approvals Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that human approval is mandatory, authenticated, content-bound, and never inferred
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Legend**: `[M]` mandatory (a constitution MUST, an approved requirement, or an approved decision); `[O]` optional enhancement or backlog boundary. `G0` is evaluable now against the approved specification, plan, ADRs, and contracts; `G1` is evaluable after `/speckit-tasks` and `/speckit-analyze`, before implementation. `{Detects: ...}` links an item to a failure pattern in the [README](README.md) detection matrix. Dimension tags: Completeness, Clarity, Consistency, Measurability, Coverage, Traceability, Edge Case, Assumption, Conflict, Gap.
## Gate Inventory and Enforcement

- [ ] CHK001 - Is each of the 10 gates defined with trigger, subject, approve, reject, timeout, and escalate behavior? [Completeness, Orchestration §6] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are the eight required approval topics covered (ambiguity, architecture, security-sensitive, destructive, exception, risk acceptance, release readiness, final submission)? [Coverage, Plan §2.4] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is skipping a gate defined as a failure, detectable when a path advances without a recorded decision? [Coverage, Spec FR-114 NAC, POL-HUM-003] [M, G0] {Detects: missing-approval-enforcement}
- [ ] CHK004 - Is approval inferred from silence, timeout, or agent action explicitly prohibited, with the expected outcome (escalate, then safe-stop)? [Clarity, Spec FR-114, FR-115, POL-HUM-004] [M, G0] {Detects: approval-from-silence}
- [ ] CHK005 - Are the timeouts (24 h logical, one escalation, second 24 h) and the meaning of escalation with a single approver unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec PVT-008, ASM-003, Orchestration §6] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the outcome for a response after safe-stop defined (rejected, logged, run stays SAFE_STOPPED)? [Edge Case, Spec DEC-041] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are simulated timeouts required to be labelled "simulated 24-hour timeout"? [Coverage, Spec DEC-044] [M, G0] {Detects: fabricated-results}

## Identity and Content Binding

- [ ] CHK008 - Is approver proof defined (separate credential, identity string, role string) with every denial audited? [Completeness, Spec DEC-037, DEC-101, DEC-110, ADR-007] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are the roles APPROVER, AGENT, and READER defined and distinguished from the Reviewer and Release Owner role strings? [Consistency, Spec DEC-012, DEC-018] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is each decision bound to the reviewed content hash, with the outcome of a stale hash defined? [Completeness, Spec FR-123, Approval schema] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is it defined when an approval becomes invalid (material change) and when it stays valid? [Clarity, Spec DEC-046, FR-123] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the dual-gate rule (G-AMB as G-CHG) limited to an exact match, with the divergence case defined? [Clarity, ADR-022, Spec DEC-090] [M, G0]

## Outcomes and Evidence

- [ ] CHK013 - Are rejection outcomes defined (path stops, impact identified, re-plan proposed, nothing left running)? [Completeness, Spec FR-116] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is repeated or conflicting decision handling defined (idempotent repeat versus 409)? [Edge Case, Reliability §3] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is release-readiness approval defined to cover the list of conditional passes? [Coverage, ADR-014, Compliance §4.1] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is approval evidence (EV-APPROVAL) required to come from a human actor and never be inferred? [Measurability, Spec Evidence Catalogue] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are signed approvals labelled backlog and non-binding? [Coverage, Plan §6.1 BL-03] [O, G0]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items marked `[Gap]` or `[Conflict]` name a place where the current documents are silent or disagree; they are findings for the reviewer to resolve, not pre-judged results
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially within this file (`CHK001` onward); cite them as `<file>:CHKnnn`
